purpose: Define endpoint currencies, typed nulls, non-interference checks, and synthetic sensor-sensitivity tests for the W0 unary-lowering canary.

typed_nulls.ZERO_MEASURED: The object, intervention, and evaluator exist and a zero difference was measured.
typed_nulls.ZERO_BY_SCOPE: A checked scope/non-interference argument proves the intervention cannot write or alter the named account.
typed_nulls.N_A_NOT_READY: The value has no current semantics because a required object or ledger is absent.
typed_nulls.UNKNOWN_UNMEASURED: The value is well-defined but was not measured.
typed_nulls.CENSORED: Measurement began but the frozen budget did not produce the target verdict.
typed_nulls.SENSOR_UNVALIDATED: The evaluator exists but has not passed synthetic sensitivity controls.
typed_nulls.NOT_REACHED: The execution stage was not entered; this must not be represented by numeric zero.

rectangle_universe.production_definition: All integer axis-aligned rectangles inside the 70x70 grid with width>=6 and height>=6.
rectangle_universe.strict_order: R1 beats R2 iff area1>area2 or area1==area2 and min_side1>min_side2.
rectangle_universe.rectangle_identity: (x,y,width,height); equal score does not merge coordinates.

L_t.definition: Highest lex score with an admitted complete certified-exact witness.

U_t.definition: Highest lex score not covered by a current sound rectangle-level exclusion in the same context.
U_t.qualification: conditional research upper ledger, not production certified

M_t.definition: Count of coordinate-distinct admissible rectangles whose score is strictly lex-better than L_t and which are not soundly excluded.
M_t.reason: L_t is ABSENT; the canary must not invent a numeric sentinel.

G_t.definition: Count of unresolved lex score bands strictly above L_t.

B_t.definition: Count of unresolved coordinate-distinct rectangles in the current highest unresolved score band U_t.
B_t.reason: No complete rectangle-level exclusion registry/evaluator is admitted for this canary.

H_t.definition: Histogram of unresolved coordinate-distinct rectangles by lex score band.

canary_expected_transaction.justification: The Judgment quantifies only binding selections under one fixed layout and fixed rectangle; it produces neither a complete witness nor a rectangle-level universal exclusion.

search_envelope_types.MODEL_SIZE: Counts of model variables and constraints.
search_envelope_types.BOX_DOMAIN: Per-variable marginal-domain cardinalities or their product/log proxy; not a count of jointly feasible assignments.
search_envelope_types.OBSERVED_TRACE: Counts observed in the frozen execution trace; not a mathematical total family cardinality.
search_envelope_types.EXACT_CARDINALITY: Used only when an explicitly finite domain has been exhaustively enumerated.

sensitivity_tests.expected: L_t increases and M_t strictly decreases
L_t increases under the second lex key

sensitivity_tests.mutation: exclude one but not all rectangles in the current highest unresolved score band
sensitivity_tests.expected: B_t decreases by one while U_t is unchanged

sensitivity_tests.mutation: exclude every rectangle in the current highest unresolved score band
sensitivity_tests.expected: U_t moves to the next score band and G_t decreases by one

sensitivity_tests.mutation: exclude one rectangle whose score is not strictly above L_t
sensitivity_tests.expected: M_t, G_t, U_t, and B_t remain unchanged

sensitivity_tests.mutation: apply the same witness or exclusion twice
sensitivity_tests.expected: all endpoint currencies are unchanged on the second application

sensitivity_tests.mutation: submit an exclusion with a mismatching contextHash
sensitivity_tests.expected: fail closed; no endpoint currency changes
M_t and G_t become N_A_NOT_READY rather than numeric zero

sensitivity_tests.mutation: move 10 synthetic cost units from binding to routing with total cost unchanged
sensitivity_tests.expected: stage shares change while total cost remains unchanged

sensitivity_tests.mutation: mark routing stage as not entered
sensitivity_tests.expected: routing cost is NOT_REACHED rather than numeric zero

sensitivity_tests.mutation: remove one value from a four-valued binding slot
sensitivity_tests.expected: BOX_DOMAIN target cardinality changes from 4 to 3 while no exact joint-count claim is emitted

production_endpoint_zero_requires: no tracked certified or publication artifact written
acceptance.history_policy: Future metric revisions create V2; V1 definitions and historical verdicts are not rewritten.
